findings.text: internal/console/answer.go: chatAskPress adds an unlocked stalePool check but retains the streamed execution path. If the source changes between this check and the writer's locked recheck, the consumed attempt fails after SSE headers have been sent, returning HTTP 200 rather than the required 409. Execute the captured change through poolPress before opening the stream, stream only its successful result, and cover a source change in this gap.
